description: List the channels in a Space, General first. Use channels[].channel_id as channel_id, and continue while has_more is true. No account is needed for Community Spaces; a private Space needs membership.

cursor.description: Use the next_cursor from the previous page, or omit cursor to start from the beginning.

regex.description: Filter channels by regex on title, purpose. Needs sign-in. No lookaround, backreferences or \p; \w \d \s \b are ASCII. Case-insensitive, ^ $ per line, . stops at newlines: (?-i) (?-m) (?s) at the start change that. At most 256 characters and 62 positions: one per character, class or anchor, counting each alternative and repeated copy, so .* not .{0,100}. limit counts rows read; an empty page with has_more true means keep paging.

space_id.description: commons, or an ID from space_list.

name: space_list_channels
title: List a Space's channels
